notes.title: New Patch in the Works for Lilith Rising: Season 2!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers,  

We’re thrilled to share not just one but TWO exciting updates with you!  
[hr][/hr]
First, let’s talk about *Lilith Rising: Season 2*. A brand-new patch is in development, and it’s packed with steamy upgrades:  
[list]  
[*] [b]New Sex Animations:[/b] Fresh, high-quality animations will heat things up like never before.  
[*] [b]Voice Acting:[/b] These animations will now include voiceovers, bringing an even deeper level of immersion to your experience.  
[/list]  
But that’s not all…  

Jubei Games is also hard at work on the next installment in the Lilith Rising saga: [b]Lilith Rising Valhalla![/b]  
To give you a taste of what’s to come, here’s a sneak peek at the design of the main menu currently in development:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914940/b4860d79826059c6850f1e1565b6bd26d84f0f73.png[/img]
We’re pouring our passion into this next chapter, and we can’t wait to share more details with you in the future!  
[hr][/hr]
[h3] Join the Conversation [/h3]  
Want to share your thoughts or feedback? Join the discussions on our Steam Community page ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2864850/discussions/]here[/url]) or hop onto our Discord server to connect with other fans and the development team directly.  

[url=https://discord.gg/8j3NkHD2qt style=button]Join Our Discord[/url]  

[hr][/hr]  

Thank you for being part of the Lilith Rising adventure. Stay tuned for more updates on both Season 2 and Valhalla!  

Warm regards,  
Jubei Games

notes.title: Lilith Rising version 1.0.3s
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/b4b849b1ff6bac037420978794b084b1229e7a8c.jpg[/img]

Friends, 
Finally version 1.0.3s is live, 
and Season 2 is well on it's way in production. 

Version 1.0.3s include:
1. Voice acting to all animations / videos!
2. Choice implemented to select which mission to go on in episode 2. 
3. Various graphical bug fixes. 
4. Gameplay smoothing in various locations. 

We hope you'll like the new video voice overs, 

Prepare for a new update on season 2 soon. 

--
Jubei Games

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2s
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44230062/13358251aff3453907469f47437c4e8d149dd987.jpg[/img]

[b]General:[/b]
We've got a long list of fixes and working diligently to address all of them, 
in this patch we've fixed some major issues, and added the gallery. 

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added Gallery feature, for images and animations, to view images or replay the animations you've unlocked during gameplay - it will work on any save. 
[*] Achievements reset bug was fixed, achievements are now persistent. 
[*] Fixed some issues with the Chinese translations where some lines were showing the default language. 
[/olist]

[b]Future Updates:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Add more SFX and Vocals to the animations
[*] Add more camera angles to the animations
[*] Less intrusive buttons for the animations for smoother loops. 
[*] Add more cut content especially for Episode 4
[*] Add more localization languages: Russian, Spanish, Turkish, French and Portuguese are next on the list (more to come). 
[*] Relationship meter, where choices effect the dialogue. 
[*] Fix the known bug with Jezz not recognizing the choices you've made. 
[*] Many more fixes. 
[/olist]
